title: Radiometric Correction of Close-Range Spectral Image Blocks Captured Using an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle with a Radiometric Block Adjustment
methods_read: Sections 2.1.1–2.1.3, equations 1–16, pages 4–7; sensor calibration, radiometric tie points, visibility and weighted joint adjustment before output mosaics.
verified_method: Calibrated sensor images, camera model/DSM-projected repeated radiometric tie points and reference panels enter a weighted joint adjustment of per-image relative gains, absolute reflectance transformation and empirical Walthall anisotropy terms. Model selection/weights depend on illumination and object conditions; outputs follow adjustment.
actual_flight_implication: Need calibrated original images, per-image camera/visibility geometry, panels or justified irradiance constraints and sufficient supported observations; an uncalibrated mosaic or generic overlap count is insufficient. Their Walthall formulation is not our LiDenseR implementation.
PFT_limit: Object-dependent weighting and shadows matter. Preserve vegetation mixtures; test independent target/angle and spectral performance, not just uniformity.

authors: Crucil, Zhang, Pauly and Van Oost
title: A Semi-Empirical Anisotropy Correction Model for UAS-Based Multispectral Images of Bare Soil
methods_read: Sections 2.1–2.3, pages 3–6: calibrated images, adjusted orientation, homogeneous bare-soil training and pre-mosaic ANIF.
verified_method: Uses bundle-adjusted orientation, camera intrinsics and sun geometry to form per-image relative angles and ANIF normalization before final Pix4D orthomosaics. Training deliberately selects flat homogeneous bare soil; manufacturer radiometric/vignette/black-level processing is handled before corrected imagery enters the final mosaic stage, with separate validation.
actual_flight_implication: Recover camera orientation/intrinsics and input calibration before applying an angular model. Preserve processing flags to avoid rerunning upstream radiometric operations. Do not transfer a bare-soil ANIF model to shrub/tree PFTs without validation.
PFT_limit: Homogeneity assumptions are restrictive; genuine species/structure gradients must not become a fitted illumination correction.

authors: Ahn, Kim, Lim, Jin, Kim and Choi
title: Minimizing Seam Lines in UAV Multispectral Image Mosaics Utilizing Irradiance, Vignette, and BRDF
methods_read: Sections 2.1–2.2 and 3.1–3.4: purpose-designed dome/vignette/validation flights, reference tarp, irradiance and image filters.
verified_method: Separates irradiance, vignetting and BRDF using calibrated reference instrumentation, a reference tarp and purpose-designed dome/vignette flights; derives image filters and evaluates separate validation mosaics and overlap settings. It is a DJI M3M-specific field workflow, not proof that any Metashape mosaic already received BRDF correction.
actual_flight_implication: Inventory raw calibration, irradiance and upstream filter settings. Cleaner seams do not establish PFT reflectance accuracy, and their calibrated directional acquisition cannot be assumed for our mapping flights.
PFT_limit: Validate biological spectra, indices and independent observations in addition to seam metrics; keep Goldhill's proven downstream failure distinct.

title: The Method of Multi-Angle Remote Sensing Observation Based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and the Validation of BRDF
methods_read: Sections 2.1–2.3, 3 and model comparison in section 4: explicit camera projection, solar geometry, panels and planned hemispheric observations.
verified_method: Designs target-centred hemispheric multi-angle acquisition, reconstructs camera/sun geometry and uses reference-panel observations before comparing M-Walthall, RPV and RTLSR models. Their experimental model ranking is domain-specific and RTLSR uses LiSparseR, not a general endorsement of LiDenseR.
actual_flight_implication: Require same-target repeated observations and assess actual angular conditioning; overlapping mapping photos or a spatial angle map alone do not establish identifiability. Do not choose RPV or another model merely because it performed best there.
PFT_limit: Plan held-out directions/targets and transfer checks; model and reference domain must match the vegetation and sensor application.
